purpose: Persist observed production failure modes and their required automated recovery behavior. This ledger is operational evidence, not conversational memory.

incidents.symptom: Direct SSE workbook request returned HTTP 403 from GitHub hosted runner.
incidents.root_cause: SSE anti-automation / runner egress filtering; endpoint identity itself remained valid.
incidents.permanent_control: Use real Chromium page network path; classify 403 as SOURCE_BLOCKED; never replace with third-party data.
incidents.regression_control: SSE browser evidence records landing/payload status, cookies, request/response headers and workbook signature.

incidents.symptom: GitHub Actions failed before checkout because action metadata download returned Service Unavailable / timeout.
incidents.root_cause: GitHub Actions infrastructure failure before business code execution.
incidents.permanent_control: Separate infrastructure failure from code failure; retry failed job without changing business logic.
incidents.regression_control: Do not open a code repair phase if checkout/setup did not complete.

incidents.symptom: SZSE official JSON occasionally reset the connection.
incidents.permanent_control: Bounded independent retry with explicit exhaustion failure; preserve SSE raw input across SZSE retries.
incidents.regression_control: Deterministic replay must produce identical normalized hashes after successful retries.

incidents.symptom: Workflow hard-coded official list count at 651 and rejected a valid 652-row update.
incidents.root_cause: Mutable market data was encoded as a constant gate.
incidents.permanent_control: Validate actual row count against each official source's declared record count; never hard-code live list size.
incidents.regression_control: Replay counts and official declared counts must match dynamically.

incidents.symptom: Official OUT adjustment was mapped to NOT_ELIGIBLE instead of retained sell-only rights.
incidents.root_cause: Eligibility state machine collapsed buy eligibility and disposal rights.
incidents.permanent_control: OUT maps to SELL_ONLY while the security remains HKEX-listed; terminal non-eligibility requires separate explicit evidence.
incidents.regression_control: R2C tests cover single-channel and both-channel OUT transitions and future-event leakage.

incidents.symptom: Run #21 succeeded from one GitHub hosted runner region while Run #23 received SSE landing and payload HTTP 403 from another runner region.
incidents.root_cause: SSE accessibility varies by hosted-runner egress/IP/region; a single successful run is not proof of stable availability.
incidents.permanent_control: Persist last-known-good official baseline, classify source blocking, keep Canonical unchanged on degraded runs, and prohibit stale evidence from publication.
incidents.regression_control: Resilience decision emits FRESH_PASS vs DEGRADED_CONTINUITY vs BLOCKED_NO_FRESH_SOURCE and a publication_allowed flag.

non_negotiable_policies: Official SSE/SZSE/HKEX evidence only for eligibility authority.
Third-party portals, brokers and search snippets never silently substitute for an unavailable official source.
A stale last-known-good snapshot may preserve continuity but may not be promoted as fresh/current.
Source and infrastructure failures do not justify changing investment logic.
No candidate, simulation, real-account or order mutation in HKCU-1 source-recovery logic.
